content: Sort UI: segmented control (2-5 options) works when options are a small linear set on the same dataset and needs to be reachable in one tap -- good fit for 3-4 sort options like preco/area/recentes. Bottom sheet suits richer choice sets (label + direction, more options) and keeps the sort control out of the way until requested. Avoid stacking a bottom sheet for sort UNDER an already-open filter sheet.
